not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested shaman hex.

chant.name: Chant
description: ::ab{title="&L&Chant (Su)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A shaman can chant as a @HLmove_action. Any creature that is within 30 feet that is under the effects of the shaman's ‹shamanhex/charm›, ‹shamanhex/evil eye›, ‹shamanhex/fortune›, ‹shamanhex/fury›, or ‹shamanhex/misfortune› hex has that effect's duration extended by 1 round." special="A shaman cannot select both this hex and the witch's ‹hex/cackle› hex."}

charm.name: Charm
description: ::ab{title="&L&Charm (Su)&FN&" icon=magic ability="A shaman charms an animal or humanoid creature within 30 feet by beckoning and speaking soothing words. This improves the attitude of an animal or humanoid creature by 1 step, as if the shaman had successfully used the ‹skill/Diplomacy› skill. The effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the shaman's Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A successful Will saving throw negates this effect." special="Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.This is a mind-affecting charm effect." imp8="This effect improves the attitude of the creature by 2 steps. "}

draconic_resilience.name: Draconic Resilience
description: ::ab{title="&L&Draconic Resilience (Ex)&FN&" icon=protect ability="The shaman grants a creature she touches some of the magically resilient nature of dragons, causing the creature to be immune to magical sleep effects for a number of rounds equal to the shaman's level." imp7="The creature is also immune to paralysis for this duration." special="Once a creature has benefited from the draconic resilience hex, it cannot benefit from this hex again for 24 hours."}

evil_eye.name: Evil Eye
description: ::ab{title="&L&Evil Eye (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="The shaman causes doubt to creep into the mind of a foe within 30 feet that she can see. The target takes a -2 penalty on one of the following (shaman's choice): ability checks, AC, attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. This hex lasts a number of rounds equal to 3 + the shaman's Wisdom modifier. A successful Will saving throw reduces this to just 1 round." imp8="The penalty increases to -4." special="This is a mind-affecting effect."}

fetish.name: Fetish
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fetish (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="The shaman receives ‹feat/Craft Wondrous Item› as a bonus feat and gains a +4 insight bonus on ‹skill/Spellcraft› checks to identify magic items permanently."}

fortune.name: Fortune
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fortune (Su)&FN&" icon=roll ability="The shaman grants a creature within 30 feet a bit of good luck for 1 round. The target can call upon this good luck once per round, allowing it to reroll any ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, taking the better result. The target creature must to decide to use this ability before the first roll is made." incrementPlain="The duration of this hex~0~8" incrementEnd=" rounds." special="Once a creature has benefited from the *fortune* hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours."}

fury.name: Fury
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fury (Su)&FN&" icon=boost-def ability="A shaman incites a creature within 30 feet into a primal fury. The target receives a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against fear for a number of rounds equal to the shaman's Wisdom modifier." increment="p!These bonuses~0~8~3" special="Once a creature has benefited from the *fury* hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours."}

healing.name: Healing
description: ::ab{title="&L&Healing (Su)&FN&" icon=aid ability="A shaman soothes the wounds of those she touches. This acts as ‹spell/cure light wounds›, using the shaman's caster level." special="Once a creature has benefited from the *healing* hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours." imp5="This acts as ‹spell/cure moderate wounds›."}

intimidating_display.name: Intimidating Display
description: ::ab{title="&L&Intimidating Display (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The shaman can call upon some of the majesty and power of dragons to cow her enemies. The shaman gains ‹feat/Dazzling Display› as a bonus feat, even if she does not meet the prerequisites, and she can use it even when not wielding a weapon."}

misfortune.name: Misfortune
description: ::ab{title="&L&Misfortune (Su)&FN&" icon=roll-lower ability="The shaman causes a creature within 30 feet to suffer grave misfortune for 1 round. Anytime the creature makes an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, it must roll twice and take the worse result. A successful Will saving throw negates this hex." incrementPlain="The duration of this hex~0~8" incrementEnd=" rounds." special="This hex affects all rolls the target must make while it lasts. Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours."}

secret.name: Secret
description: ::ab{title="&L&Secret (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="The shaman receives one ‹main/metamagic feat› as a bonus feat. The shaman must meet the prerequisites for the feat."}

shapeshift.name: Shapeshift
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shapeshift (Su)&FN&" icon=magic ability="The shaman transforms herself into another form for a number of minutes per day equal to her level, as ‹spell/alter self›. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments. Changing form (including changing back) is a @HLstandard_action that doesn't provoke an attack of opportunity." imp8="This ability works as ‹spell/beast shape I›." imp12="This ability works as ‹spell/beast shape II›." imp16="This ability works as ‹spell/beast shape III›." imp20="This ability works as ‹spell/beast shape IV›."}

silkstring_snare.name: Silkstring Snare
description: ::ab{title="&L&Silkstring Snare (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="The shaman causes ribbons of spider silk to erupt from the ground beneath a single creature. The target must succeed at a Reflex save or be ‹rule/entangled› and anchored in place. The foe can escape the silk as a @HLstandard_action with a successful ‹skill/Escape Artist› or Strength check at the same DC, or by dealing an amount of damage to the silk equal to double the shaman's class level (the silk has hardness 0).~~~This hex lasts a number of rounds equal to 3 + the shaman's Wisdom modifier." special="A creature affected by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours."}

tongues.name: Tongues
description: ::ab{title="&L&Tongues (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="The shaman understands any spoken language for a number of minutes per day equal to her level, as ‹spell/comprehend languages›. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments." imp5="A shaman can use this ability to speak any language, as ‹spell/tongues›."}

ward.name: Ward
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ward (Su)&FN&" icon=protect ability="The shaman places a protective ward over one creature. The *warded* creature receives a +2 deflection bonus to AC and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws. This effect lasts until the *warded* creature is hit or fails a saving throw." special="A shaman knows when a *warded* creature is no longer protected. A shaman can have only one *ward* active at a time. If the shaman uses this hex while a previous *ward* is still active, that previous *ward* immediately ends. A shaman cannot use this ability on herself." increment="p!These bonuses~0~8~3~1"}

wings.name: Wings
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wings (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="The shaman can grow a pair of wings for a number of minutes per day equal to her level. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments.~~~Initially, these wings lack the power to allow the shaman to fly, but the shaman can use them as a secondary ‹umr/natural attack› that deals 1d3 points of damage (1d2 for a Small shaman)." imp3="She can use the wings to safely descend any distance, as if using the ‹spell/feather fall› spell." imp7="She can use the wings to fly with poor maneuverability and a fly speed of 30 feet, but the shaman must land at the end of each turn or fall." special="A shaman of 8th level or higher can select the wings hex a second time. This doubles the number of minutes per day the shaman can use her wings (2 minutes per level), and allows her to fly with average maneuverability and a fly speed of 30 feet while the wings are active."}

witch_hex.name: Witch Hex
description: ::ab{title="&L&Witch Hex&FN&" icon=power ability="The shaman selects ‹ability/any one »hex<es› normally available through the ‹class/witch«'s› *hex* class feature. She treats her shaman level as her witch level when determining the powers and abilities of the hex. She uses her Wisdom modifier in place of her Intelligence modifier for the hex." special="She cannot select major hexes or grand hexes using this ability. The shaman cannot select a witch hex that has the same name as a shaman hex."}
